results.name: the + button creates an empty layer (not a rectangle)
black square on the layer, then right-click › Blending Options opens Layer Style
Drop Shadow (distance 20, size 0) and outside red Stroke render and export
Color Overlay and Fill Opacity 0: overlay stays, content hidden; Cancel discards changes
Blend If (This Layer black 10) hides the black content; undo restores in one step
Clipping mask: a full red layer clipped to the square only shows inside it
right-click on the canvas with a selection shows selection commands
Camera Raw Filter: every panel present; Exposure +1 brightens; settings reopen with the layer
Fill layer (Solid Color) and adjustment layers (Invert, Levels) affect layers below; undo removes them
Export › PSD writes editable layers in Photoshop order with masks and effects
